🇮🇳🤝🇦🇷 Rotary Friendship Exchange – A Celebration of Global Friendship

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown | District 3141, India
RFE with District 4895 | Buenos Aires, Argentina

As part of the Rotary Friendship Exchange 2026–27, 10 Rotarians from Rotary, District 3141, India, had the privilege of connecting with fellow Rotarians of District 4895, Buenos Aires, Argentina.

One of the most memorable moments of the exchange was the Flag Exchange Ceremony at the San Isidro Club, one of Argentina’s oldest and most historic club. The ceremony was hosted in the warm company of Rotary Club Punta chica Distrito 4895– Buneos Aries Argentina.

The exchange of flags beautifully represented the spirit of Rotary—friendship, fellowship, cultural understanding and international goodwill. Two Rotary flags, two countries and two cultures came together to create a bond that goes far beyond geographical boundaries.

The warm welcome extended by our Argentina Rotary friends made the occasion truly special. The gathering was filled with camaraderie, meaningful conversations and the shared joy of being part of the worldwide Rotary family.

From Mumbai to Buenos Aires – Flags Exchanged, Friendships Strengthened, Hearts Connected. 🇮🇳❤️🇦🇷

A memorable chapter in the Rotary Friendship Exchange 2026–27, strengthening the beautiful bond between District 3141 and District 4895.
